language: JavaScript (Node.js 20+ / 原生浏览器 ES modules)

workflow_checks.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[]); if(!a.options.some(x=>x.available)||a.calendar.length!==6)process.exit(1); console.log(a.course.name);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),go("north")]); if(a.rejected?.code!=="tide"||a.state.tick!==3)process.exit(1); console.log(a.rejected.message);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("creek"),go("creek"),k("charge")]); if(a.rejected||a.state.power!==10||a.state.tick!==5)process.exit(1); console.log(a.state.power);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),k("tune")]); if(a.rejected?.code!=="beacon"||a.score.signal!==2)process.exit(1); console.log(a.score.signal);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),k("wait"),go("crossing"),k("tune"),go("creek"),k("finish")]); if(!a.score.won||a.state.tick!==9||a.score.points!==98)process.exit(1); console.log(a.score.points);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const data=[go("west"),k("tune"),k("wait"),go("crossing"),k("tune"),go("creek"),k("finish")]; if(JSON.stringify(briefing(c,data))!==JSON.stringify(briefing(c,JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)))))process.exit(1); console.log(data.length);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReachSpecial as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach-special.mjs"; import {score} from "./server/voyage/score.mjs"; const st=(tick,sigs,p=1)=>({tick,at:"dock",power:p,lit:[],signals:sigs,status:"returned",log:[]}); const a=score(c,st(14,{shoal:"receive",skerry:"send",reed:"receive"})); const full={reed:"send",foam:"receive",shoal:"send",skerry:"receive"}; const b=score(c,st(24,full)),d=score(c,st(26,full)),e=score(c,st(27,full)); if(a.signal!==4||a.points!==107||b.points!==87||d.points!==123||e.points!==121||d.signal!==6)process.exit(1); console.log(a.points,b.points,d.points,e.points);'
